datasets.name: 535d6456
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Bronze rows ingested' AS check_metric,
  bronze_rows AS row_count
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Duplicate booking IDs',
  duplicate_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Invalid stay dates (check-out not after check-in)',
  invalid_date_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Missing city',
  missing_city_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Missing total amount',
  missing_total_amount_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Missing nights',
  missing_nights_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Missing booking channel',
  missing_channel_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Clean rows (silver)',
  clean_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Rejected rows (silver)',
  rejected_rows
FROM
  workspace.default.gold_data_quality
